question: Has Sesajal been acquired by or merged with another company? Who owns Sesajal now?
markdown:
Sesajal has not been acquired or merged
. It remains an independent, privately held Mexican agro-industrial company founded in 1989 and owned by its founding family and leadership, guided by founder José Luis González Íñigo. Instead of being bought, Sesajal acts as an acquirer and investor in other brands.
Food Dive
Ownership and Investments
Independent Status:
Headquartered in Guadalajara, Jalisco, Mexico, Grupo Sesajal remains under private ownership.
PR Newswire
Chosen Foods Acquisition & Sale:
Sesajal previously acquired majority ownership of the U.S. avocado oil brand Chosen Foods in 2017, but later sold its majority stake in Chosen Foods to private equity firm Butterfly Equity in 2021.
PR Newswire
Rhythm Superfoods Stake:
As reported in
⁠Sesajal takes minority stake in Rhythm Superfoods - Food Dive
, Sesajal also holds a minority investment in the plant-based snack brand Rhythm Superfoods.
